description: The file defines the SortOption class, which encapsulates a sort expression and direction used for sorting in queries within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides constructors, getters, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

classes.name: SortOption
classes.description: A class representing sorting options with a specific expression and direction used in query operations within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: SortOption
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the sort expression and direction, ensuring they are non-null.

methods.name: getSortExpression
methods.description: Returns the sort expression used for sorting.

methods.name: getSortDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction of the sort (ascending or descending).

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on sortExpression and sortDirection.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on sortExpression and sortDirection.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the SortOption instance.
